reason: A matter-aware legal workspace focused primarily on indexing, previewing, extracting, revising, and generating legal documents, with optional OCR and task tracking.

summaries.zh: 面向法律事务的工作区插件，提供文件索引与搜索、文档预览和提取、DOCX/PDF 生成与修订、可选 OCR 及任务跟踪功能。
summaries.en: A legal matter workspace plugin for file indexing and search, document preview and extraction, DOCX/PDF creation and revision, optional OCR, and task tracking.

capabilities: Previews PDF, image, text, and extracted DOCX content
Creates and revises DOCX and PDF deliverables
Writes new document versions and local indexes
Runs OCR through a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint after explicit approval
Creates and displays Harness goals and todos
